tool_input.command:
cd /home/sites/phlix/phlix-contracts
git add -A
git -c user.name='detain' -c user.email='detain@interserver.net' commit -q -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat: @phlix/contracts v0.1.0 — shared TS DTO/API-contract types

TypeScript mirror of detain/phlix-shared + the server JSON response shapes,
so mobile/windows/tizen stop redeclaring divergent types. Pure types + tiny
helpers, no runtime deps.

- media/playback/auth/hub/library/events DTOs (server snake_case wire names;
  hub DTOs use the camelCase toPayload() keys)
- canonical MediaItem reconciled from server schema; actors flat, cast[] rich
- X-Phlix-* header constants + buildPhlixHeaders + DeviceType union
- ticks helpers (TICKS_PER_SECOND=10_000_000); 26 vitest tests; vite ES+CJS

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && echo "contracts: $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"

cd /home/sites/phlix/phlix-syncplay
git add -A
git -c user.name='detain' -c user.email='detain@interserver.net' commit -q -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat: @phlix/syncplay v0.1.0 — shared SyncPlay protocol + NTP time-sync

Single canonical implementation of the Phlix SyncPlay wire protocol, replacing
divergent per-client copies. Framework-agnostic (inject send + clock), no deps.

- all 19 syncplay_* message types (PROTOCOL_VERSION=1) + payload interfaces
- TimeSync mirroring server TimeSync.php (weighted 1/rtt offset, drift 0.1,
  variance<50ms) incl. drift calc Windows+Mobile lacked
- RAW JSON framing (drops Tizen wrapper; decode still unwraps); SPEC.md
- normalizes Windows/Tizen/Roku divergences; 45 vitest tests

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && echo "syncplay: $(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
